blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Tool-call judges evaluate argument values proposed by LLM agents. We find that they accept a correct value less often when their input holds no reference for it, that is, no text that says what the value should be. This happens when the value is a default value from the function schema that the user did not mention, when it has to be inferred, or when the text it comes from was cut from the judge input. We call this drop in acceptance the derivation gap. It appears across all seven judges we evaluate, including System One models CLM and Jev. The gap is not only a truncation artifact: correct default values have the largest gap on a benchmark with no truncation. A controlled source-relocation test shows that judges follow the reference in their input: they favor a visible incorrect value over a correct value whose source is hidden. We introduce DeRef (Derived Reference): a separate model reads the full history without seeing the candidate and writes a reference for the judge. Across three benchmarks, DeRef improves overall argument AUROC for all judges tested. On the controlled test, it raises AUROC from chance or below to between 98.40 and 99.59.
blocks.zh: 工具调用法官评价LLM代理商提出的论证值. 我们发现,当它们的投入没有提及价值时,即没有说明价值的文本时,它们接受的正确价值较少。 当该值是用户未提及的函数图案的默认值时,当必须推断时,或者当它来自的文本被从判断器输入中切出时,就发生了这种情况. 我们把这种接受率的下降称为衍生差距。 它出现在我们评价的所有七个法官中,包括系统一模型CLM和Jev。 差距不仅仅是一个切换文物:正确的默认值在一个基准上有最大的差距,没有切换. 一个受控的源移位测试显示,法官在输入中遵循了引用:他们倾向于一个可见不正确的值,而不是一个其源被隐藏的正确值. 我们介绍De Ref (Derived Reference):一个单独的模型在不见候选人的情况下读取全部历史,并为法官写出参考. 从三个基准来看, " 参考 " 改进了对所有法官进行测试的AUROC的总体论点。 在受控试验中,它使AUROC从概率或低于98.40至99.59之间.

blocks.en:
LLM agents act through tool calls.
Wrong argument values are among the most common errors in the tool calls of LLM agents, as in FC-RewardBench (FCRB) ( Agarwal et al., 2025 ) .
Agent pipelines therefore use judges to check tool calls, as reward models ( Agarwal et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026b ; Lin et al., 2026 ) and guards before execution ( She et al., 2026 ) .
Many checks operate at the argument level, from the BFCL benchmark to ProvenanceGuard and ToolPRM ( Patil et al., 2025 ; She et al., 2026 ; Lin et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
LLM代理通过工具调用行事.
错误的参数值是LLM代理工具调用中最常见的错误之一,如FC-Reward Bench(FCRB)(Agarwal等,2025年).
因此,代理管道使用法官检查工具呼叫,作为奖励模式(Agarwal等,2025;Li等,2026b;Lin等,2026;),处决前的警卫(她等,2026.).
从BFCL基准到BolvenanceGuard和Tolprem(Patil等,2025年;She等,2026年;Lin等,2026年),许多检查都在论证层面运作.

blocks.en:
An argument judge sees the context and a proposed value, the candidate , and decides whether it is right.
But a correct value can reach a call in several ways.
It can be copied from visible text, taken from an earlier tool return, filled in from a default that the function schema specifies when the user does not mention the argument, reformatted, or inferred.
We call each way a derivation path .
Figure 1 shows one such path: a correct vehicle ID taken from an earlier tool return.
The source of the ID is not visible to the judge, and all four judges reject the value.
Correct arguments that the input does not show directly, like this ID, are accepted much less often than those it does.
We call this drop in acceptance rate the derivation gap .
blocks.zh:
辩论法官看上下文和拟议价值,
但是,正确的价值可以从几个方面达到一个要求。
它可以从可见的文本中复制,取自更早的工具返回,从函数 schema 指定的默认中被填入,当用户未提及参数,重排,或推断出时.
我们把每一条路都称为通向之路。
图1显示了一条这样的路径:从较早的工具返回中提取的正确车辆ID。
ID的来源对法官来说并不明显,四位法官都拒绝这一价值.
正确的参数,即输入没有像这个ID那样直接显示,被接受的频率远低于它所做的.
我们把这种接受率的下降称为衍生差距。

blocks.en:
The gap appears in all seven judges we study.
Two are System One judges, scoring models that return a probability rather than text ( Kwok et al., 2026 ; Almeida, 2026 ) .
Five are LLM judges from the Qwen, Llama, and Mistral families ( Yang et al., 2025 ; Qwen Team, 2026 ; Grattafiori et al., 2024 ; Jiang et al., 2023 ) .
Scaling the judge from 4B to 27B parameters does not remove the gap.
The gap is also not only a matter of missing information: on FCRB, where nothing is cut and each default is shown, correct defaults have the largest gap.
blocks.zh:
差距出现在我们研究的所有七位法官中。
二是系统 1名评委,评分模型返回概率而非文本(Kwok等,2026;Almeida,2026.).
5名是来自Quen、Llama和Mistral家族的LLM法官(Yang等,2025;Quen Team,2026;Grattafiori等,2024;Jiang等,2023)。
将判断器从4B参数缩放到27B参数并不能消除差距.
漏洞不仅是一个缺失信息的问题:在FCRB上,没有被剪切,并且显示每个默认,正确的缺省是最大的.

blocks.en:
Controlled tests point to one cause: a judge tends to accept a value that is stated in its input, and to reject one that is not.
It does not reliably work out the correct value on its own.
When we hide the source of a correct value and leave a wrong value visible, AUROC falls to chance or below for every judge tested.
Giving the judge the full history narrows the gap on values from earlier steps.
It does not help on values that match no span of the history.
But when the input states the expected value and the reason for it, judges accept values they rejected before.
blocks.zh:
被控制的测试指出一个原因:法官倾向于接受其输入中陈述的值,拒绝非输入值.
它本身不能可靠地确定正确的价值。
当我们隐藏一个正确值的来源,留下一个错误值可见时,AUROC对每个被测试的法官来说都是偶然或低于机会.
让法官了解全部历史 缩小了早期的价值观差距
它无助于符合历史的价值观。
但当投入陈述了预期值及其原因时,法官会接受他们之前拒绝的价值观.

blocks.en:
This points to a simple lever.
If judges rely on a reference in their input, we can supply one. DeRef (Derived Reference) asks a model to read the full history without seeing the candidate.
The model writes down the expected value of each argument and where it comes from (Figure 1 b).
The judge then scores the candidate with this reference in its input.
In Figure 1 c, all four judges then accept the vehicle ID.
Unlike judges that write their own answer first, DeRef uses a separate model that reads the full history.
blocks.zh:
这说明一个简单的杠杆。
如果法官在投入中依赖参考,我们可以提供参考。 DeRef (Derived Reference)要求一个模型在不见候选人的情况下读取完整的历史.
模型写下每个参数的预期值及其来源(图1b).
法官然后在投入中参照这一内容对候选人进行评分。
在图1c中,所有四名法官均接受车辆身份证明。
与先写出自己答案的法官不同,德雷克使用单独的模型来读取完整的历史.

blocks.en:
Our contributions are as follows: (1) We identify a systematic derivation gap across seven argument judges, from System One models to a 27B LLM.
On ComplexFuncBench (CFB) and FinTrace it lies between 22.67 and 36.13 points for every judge, and on FCRB, with no truncation, correct defaults have a gap between 14.40 and 50.51 points. (2) Through controlled source relocation and reference substitution, we show that judgments track explicit reference values in the input, even when these favor an incorrect candidate over the correct one. (3) We introduce DeRef , which derives a shared reference from the full history without seeing the candidate.
Without retraining or modifying the judges, it improves overall argument AUROC for every judge tested, on all three benchmarks.
Averaged over tested judges, it is significantly above the strongest prior method, RevisEval, on every benchmark.
On the controlled test with a hidden source, it lifts every judge from chance or below to between 98.40 and 99.59.
blocks.zh:
我们的捐款如下: (1) 我们查明了从系统一模型到27B LLM的7名辩论法官之间的系统衍生差距。
在ComplexFunc Bench(CFB)和FinTrace上,每名法官的分数在22.67至36.13分之间,在FCRB上,没有分数,正确的缺省值在14.40至50.51分之间. (2) 通过有控制的源移取和参考替代,我们显示,判决跟踪输入中明确的参考值,即使这些参考值有利于不正确的候选人而不是正确的候选人。 (3) 我们介绍De Ref ,它从整个历史中得出一个共同的参考,但没有见到候选人。
不对法官进行再培训或修改,它改进了对每个法官进行测试的关于所有三项基准的总体论点。
平均比经测试的法官高,大大高于每个基准上最强的先前方法RevisEval。
在带有隐藏来源的控制测试中,它使每位法官从机会或低于机会提升到98.40至99.59之间.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Judges for tool-calling. Benchmarks check calls against gold answers, per argument ( Patil et al., 2025 ) or per call ( Zhong et al., 2025 ) ; without gold answers, learned judges score whole calls ( Agarwal et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026b ) or each argument as a step ( Lin et al., 2026 ) , and benchmarks of such judges find that they tend to label steps as correct and agree less with a reference as tasks get harder ( Li et al., 2026a ; Fan et al., 2026b ; Verma et al., 2026 ) .
Guards check calls before they run: ProvenanceGuard finds evidence for each argument with the value in hand ( She et al., 2026 ) , PACT and Agent-Sentry track where each value came from ( Fan et al., 2026a ; Sequeira et al., 2026 ) , and TwinCheck repairs a flagged call from the trace ( Dai and Huang, 2026 ) .
Jev trails GPT-6 where the verdict has to be derived rather than read off the text ( Li et al., 2026c ) , and factuality metrics drop on summaries that need deeper reasoning ( Ramprasad and Wallace, 2025 ) .
To our knowledge, none of these studies splits judge errors by derivation path.
blocks.zh:
法官负责召唤工具。 基准对照黄金答案对调(Patil等人,2025年)或每调(Zhong等人,2025年);没有黄金答案,有学识的法官会获得整调(Agarwal等人,2025年;Li等人,2026年b),或每调作为步骤(Lin等人,2026年),这些法官的基准发现,他们倾向于把步骤贴上正确标签,并不太赞同在任务越来越难时提供参考(Li等人,2026年a; Fan等,2026b;Verma等,2026).
警卫在逃跑前检查电话: 证明 Guard为每个有值(She等人,2026年),PACT和Agent-Sentry轨道(Fan等人,2026年a;Sequeira等人,2026年),以及TwinCheck从跟踪中修复一个标有标记的呼叫(Dai和Huang,2026年)的论据找到证据。
Jev追踪到GPT-6, 判决必须推导出而非读出文本(Li等, 2026c),
据我们所知,这些研究中没有任何一项能通过推导方法来判断错误。

blocks.en:
Reference-guided judging. Judges grade better with a reference, and several have the judge write its own answer before seeing the candidate ( Zheng et al., 2023 ; Zeng et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2026d ; Zhou, 2026 ; Andrade et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026e ; Dhuliawala et al., 2024 ; Raghavendra et al., 2026 ) , or revise the candidate into one ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) ; without a reference, judges agree less with experts and credit wrong answers ( Krumdick et al., 2025 ; Chalamalasetti and Vajjala, 2026 ) , and with a wrong reference they reject answers that match it ( Lee et al., 2026 ) .
These judges write the reference from the question and their own knowledge, which is often not enough for an argument judge, whose expected value can sit in a tool return cut from its input, and a reference the judge writes from its own input, as in LLMBar, stays below DeRef (Section 5.2 ).
blocks.zh:
参考指导判断。 法官的级别更优于参考,有几位法官在见到候选人之前写出自己的答案(郑等,2023;曾等,2024;李等,2026d;周等,2026;安德烈德等,2026;李等,2026e;杜利亚瓦拉等,2024;拉格哈文德拉等,2026;或将候选人修改为一人(张等,2025a;没有参考;法官较少同意专家的意见和信用错误的答案(克拉姆迪克等,2025;查拉马拉塞蒂和瓦贾拉等,2026;),错误地拒绝与之相匹配的答复(李等,2026).
这些法官从问题和他们自己的知识中写出参考文献,对于辩论法官来说往往是不够的,因为辩论法官的预期价值可以放在工具返回中,而法官从自己的投入中写出参考文献,如在LLMBar中,保留在DeRefer之下(第5.2节)。

blocks.en:
Correct content without support. A value without support in the context is not always wrong: unsupported entities in summaries are often factual ( Cao et al., 2022 ) , and RAG models often answer correctly when the context is insufficient ( Joren et al., 2025 ) .
Tool-call arguments make this common, since a correct default, format change, or inferred value has no matching span in the dialogue, and we measure how often judges treat such values as errors.
A source in the context can also go unused ( Modarressi et al., 2025 ; Kate et al., 2025 ) .
App. I discusses each line of work in more detail.
blocks.zh:
校正内容而不支持 。 没有上下文支持的值并不总是错的:摘要中不支持的实体往往是事实性的(Cao等,2022年),在上下文不充分时,RAG模型往往正确回答(Joren等,2025年).
工具调用参数使得这种常见,因为正确的默认,格式更改,或推断值在对话中没有匹配的跨度,我们衡量法官将此类值作为错误对待的频率.
上下文中的一个来源也可被使用(Modarressi等,2025;Kate等,2025)。
App. 我更详细地讨论每一行工作.

blocks.en: 3 The Derivation Gap
blocks.zh: 3 衍生差距

blocks.en:
This section identifies the derivation gap and investigates its causes.
Section 3.1 defines the judging task and five derivation paths based on how argument values relate to the history and the function schema.
Section 3.2 describes the benchmarks, judges, and judge input.
Section 3.3 measures differences in acceptance rates for correct values across paths.
Finally, Section 3.4 uses controlled tests to examine the roles of missing information and explicit reference values, motivating the introduction of DeRef in Section 4 .
blocks.zh:
本节确定衍生差距并调查其原因。
第3.1节根据论证值与历史和函数计划的关系,界定了判断任务和五个推导路径。
第3.2节介绍了基准、法官和法官的投入。
第3.3节衡量不同路径正确值接受率的差异。
最后,第3.4节使用控制测试来检查缺失信息和明确参考值的作用,促使在第4节中引入DeRef。

blocks.en: 3.1 Argument-Level Judging and Derivation Paths
blocks.zh: 3.1 辩证级判断和衍生路径

blocks.en:
Task. An agent acts in a state with history H H , which contains the user turns, earlier tool calls, and their full returns.
The agent proposes a call to a function f f with k k arguments, where argument i i has a name a i a_{i} and a value v i v_{i} .
An argument judge checks one value at a time using a context X X built from H H and the schema of f f . X X does not need to contain all of H H (Section 3.2 ), so the text that determines a correct value can be present in H H but absent from X X .
For each argument, the judge returns a score s ⁡ ( v i ∣ a i , X ) ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] s(v_{i}\mid a_{i},X)\in[0,1] , representing its estimated probability that v i v_{i} is correct.

代理提议调用一个带有 kk 参数的函数 f f, 其中参数 I 有 i a_{i} 和 value v i v_{i} 。
论证法官使用由H所建的上下文XX和ff的图案,一次检查一个值. X X不需要包含所有的H (第 3.2 节),所以决定一个正确值的文本可以存在H中,而缺失出X X.
对于每个论点,法官返回一个分数 s (v i ∣ a i, X ) ∈ [0, 1] s (v _{i}\mid a_{i}, X)\ 在 [0 1] 中,表示其估计概率 v i v_{i}正确.

blocks.en:
Derivation paths. A correct value is not always a copy of text that the judge can see.
The derivation of a value v v can be described by a source e e and a transformation t t .
The source is a span of H H or a field of the function schema, such as a default.
The transformation copies the source, changes its format, or infers a new value from it, so that t ⁡ ( e ) = v t(e)=v .
Each candidate value, whether right or wrong, has a derivation path , determined by text-matching rules (Appendix B ).
The paths capture how directly a value can be checked against the dialogue shown to the judge.
There are five path types, and a value takes the first one that matches: • Visible : v v appears in the dialogue part of X X , that is, the user turns, shown calls, and retained portions of their returns. • History-only : v v appears in H H but not in the dialogue part of X X . The matching text was cut or dropped, as for the vehicle ID in Figure 1 . • Format : v v matches a span of H H after a format-normalization step, such as converting two date expressions to the same form. • Default : v v matches a schema default or a “don’t care” value explicitly specified in the parameter description. • No-source : no match is found under the preceding rules. Correctness is determined by the benchmark’s gold call, not by the assigned path.

blocks.en: 3.2 Benchmarks and Judges
blocks.zh: 3.2 基准和法官

blocks.en:
Benchmarks. We use three tool-calling benchmarks, each with a gold call at every step (Appendix A ).
FC-RewardBench (FCRB) gives 630 single-turn requests, each with a correct call and a wrong call made by a real model ( Agarwal et al., 2025 ) .
ComplexFuncBench (CFB) has multi-step tasks with long tool returns ( Zhong et al., 2025 ) .
Its wrong calls come from the trajectories of 30 models ( AgentSuite, 2026 ) , which gives 347 correct and 644 wrong calls.
FinTrace gives 2,334 golden calls for financial queries ( Cao et al., 2026 ) and 2,334 wrong calls, each made from a golden call by changing one argument by rule.
blocks.zh:
基准。 我们使用三个工具调用基准,每个基准每个步骤都有一个金调(附录A.
FC-Reward Bench (FCRB)给出了630个单回合请求,每个请求都有正确的呼叫和由真实模型错误的呼叫(Agarwal等,2025年).
ComplexFunc Bench(CFB)具有多步任务并有长工具回放( Zh等,2025.
其错误的电话来自30个型号(AgentSuite,2026.)的出轨,这给347个正确和644个错误的电话.
FinTrace给出了2,334个金通电话进行财务查询(Cao等,2026年)和2,334个错通电话,每个错通电话都是通过规则改变一个论据从金通电话发出.

blocks.en:
Judges. We study seven judges (Appendix F ).
CLM ( Kwok et al., 2026 ) and Jev ( Almeida, 2026 ) are System One judges, scoring models that return a probability for a question about their input.
The other five are LLM judges: Qwen3 at 4B and 8B ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , Qwen3.8-27B ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) , Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 ) , and Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 ( Jiang et al., 2023 ) .
Their score is the probability of “Yes” at the first output token, with thinking turned off.
Section 3.3 reports all seven judges.
The controlled tests of Section 3.4 and the main experiments of Section 5 use four of them: CLM, Jev, Qwen3-8B, and Qwen3.8-27B.
blocks.zh:
诸法官. 我们研究7名法官(附录F)。
CLM (Kwok等, 2026年)和Jev (Almeida, 2026年)是System One评分,评分模型,它们返回一个对其输入的疑问概率.
其他五名是LLM法官:Quen3 at 4B和8B(Yang等人,2025年),Quen3.8-27B (Quen Team, 2026). Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct (Grattafiori等, 2024). Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3(Jiang等, 2023).
他们的分数是第一个产出符号“是”的概率,而思维则被关闭。
第3.3节报告所有7名法官。
第3.4节的控制试验和第5节的主要试验使用了其中4个:CLM,Jev,Qune3-8B和Qune3.8-27B.

blocks.en:
Judge input. All judges see the same context X X , which we call the Plain input .
We choose a truncated input on purpose: it keeps the last few steps and cuts each return to 1,000 characters (Appendix A ), which is the input a judge sees in practice.
Deployed agents stack cut context the same way: the OpenAI Agents SDK provides a trimmer that cuts tool outputs above 500 characters outside the last two turns, and Anthropic’s guidance for long-running agents clears old tool results and compacts earlier turns ( OpenAI, 2026 ; Rajasekaran et al., 2025 ) .
FCRB requests have no earlier calls, so nothing is cut there.
blocks.zh:
法官的投入。 所有评委都看到了相同的上下文XX,我们称之为"平原输入".
我们故意选择一个截取的输入:它保留了最后的几个步骤,并切换到每个回回1000个字符(Appendix A ),这是法官在实践中看到的输入.
OpenAI Agents SDK提供三分机, 将工具输出超过500个字符, 而Anthropic对长期代理的指导,
FCRB请求没有更早的通话,所以没有切出任何内容.

blocks.en:
Statistics. All confidence intervals (CIs) are 95% bootstrap intervals over 1,000 resamples of queries.
A difference is called significant when its CI excludes zero (Appendix C ).
blocks.zh:
统计. 所有置信间隔(CI)为95%的靴子间隔,超过1000个复刻的查询.
当它的 CI 排除为零时(附录 C.),则称为显著差异。

blocks.en: 3.3 Measuring the Gap
blocks.zh: 3.3 衡量差距

blocks.en: Table 1: Derivation gap Gap τ \mathrm{Gap}_{\tau} (in points) with Plain input, with its 95% CI below. Out of view pools the four paths other than Visible . The second column of each dataset is its main path.
blocks.zh: 表 1: 有Plain 输入的衍生差距 \ mathrm{ Gap}_{\tau} (分数), 其95% CI 如下。 除了可见的四条路之外, 每个数据集的第二列是其主要路径.

blocks.en:
Metric. We compare how often a judge accepts correct values on different derivation paths.
A judge accepts a value when its score is above a threshold.
One fixed threshold for all judges is not fair, because judges accept values at very different score levels.
On CFB, for example, Qwen3-8B accepts 80% of correct arguments at a score of 0.002, and CLM at a score of 0.631.
For each judge, dataset, and input, we therefore set a threshold τ \tau at which the judge accepts 80% of correct arguments.
Let A τ ​ ( p ) A_{\tau}(p) be the share of correct arguments on path p p that the judge accepts at τ \tau .
The derivation gap of path p p is Gap τ ​ ( p ) = A τ ​ ( Visible ) − A τ ​ ( p ) . \mathrm{Gap}_{\tau}(p)=A_{\tau}(\textsc{Visible})-A_{\tau}(p). (1) A positive gap means that correct values on p p are accepted less often than correct Visible values.
We say that values on the Visible path are in view and that values on the other four paths are out of view .
We also report the gap of the out-of-view values pooled together.
blocks.zh:
度量衡. 我们比较法官在不同衍生路径上接受正确价值的频率。
裁判员在得分高于门槛时接受一个值.
所有法官有一个固定的门槛是不公平的,因为法官接受的价值观的得分水平非常不同。
例如在CFB上,Quen3-8B以0.002分接受80%的正确论据,以0.631分接受CLM.
因此,对于每个法官,数据集和输入,我们设定了一个阈值\tau,在这个阈值中,法官接受80%的正确论据.
让A\ (p) A\ (p) 成为法官在\ (p) 接受的路径 p上正确论据的一部分。
路径p的引出缺口为:Gapτ (p) = Aτ (能见度)- Aτ (p.). \ mathrm{ Gap}_{\tau} (p) = A_{\tau} (\textsc{visible}) - A_{\tau} (p) 。 (1)正差意味着p上的正确值被接受的频率低于正确的可见值.
我们说,可见道上的价值观被看到,而其他四条道上的价值观则被看到。
我们还报告将视野外的价值观汇集在一起的差距。

blocks.en:
The gap compares acceptance rates and not AUROC within a path. This is because AUROC within a path can stay the same when a judge scores all values on that path lower, right and wrong alike. A deployed judge applies one threshold to every argument, so such a shift means more false rejections on that path.
Appendix C gives the rule for ties at τ \tau .
It also repeats the analysis with τ \tau set to accept 70% or 90%, where every CFB and FinTrace gap tested stays significant.
blocks.zh:
差距比较了接受率,而不是路径中的AUROC。 这是因为当法官在路径上给所有值都打分时,AUROC在路径中可以保持不变。 部署的法官对每一个论点都适用一个门槛,因此这种转变意味着在这条道路上有更多的错误的拒绝.
附 录 C在\tau 上给出了联系规则。
它还用\tau来重复分析,它设定接受70%或90%,其中每个CFB和FinTrace的测试差距仍然很大。

blocks.en:
Results. Table 1 gives the gap for all seven judges.
For each benchmark, it reports the pooled out-of-view gap and the gap on the main out-of-view path of that benchmark: Default on FCRB, History-only on CFB, and No-source on FinTrace.
On CFB and FinTrace, the out-of-view gap is significant for every judge.
On FCRB it is small, and defaults carry the largest gap.
Scale does not remove the gap, since Qwen3.8-27B, the largest judge we run, has a significant out-of-view gap on all three benchmarks, between 12.29 and 29.76 points.
blocks.zh:
结果。 表1列出了所有7名法官的差距。
对于每个基准,它都报告该基准的主要外视路径上的集合外视差距和差距:FCRB上的默认,CFB上的仅是历史,FinTrace上的无源.
在CFB和FinTrace上,视线外差距对每位法官都很大.
在FCRB上,它很小,而默认的缺口最大.
Scale没有去除这一差距,因为我们所跑出的最大裁判员Qwen3.8-27B在所有三个基准上都有很大的出视差距,在12.29到29.76分之间.

blocks.en:
Base rates. A gap could also arise from the base rate of a path, the proportion of its values that are correct: if the base rate of a path is lower, a judge would be right to trust its values less.
On FCRB, 77% of default values are correct, against 75% of values in view.
On CFB, 83% of history-only values are correct, against 82% in view.
So base rates do not explain the gap in either case.
On FinTrace, only 45% of no-source values are correct, against 97.5% in view, so this low base rate may account for part of the gap.
blocks.zh:
基本费率。 路径的基准率及其正确价值的比例也可能产生差距:如果路径的基准率更低,法官就应该更信任其价值。
在FCRB中,77%的默认值是正确的,相对于所查看值的75%。
在CFB上,83%的仅以历史为主的数值是正确的,相对于82%的查看率.
因此,基率并不能解释两者的差额。
在FinTrace上,只有45%的无源值是正确的,相对于97.5%的视图,因此这一低基率可能占了部分差距.

blocks.en:
Truncation is not the whole story. On CFB, truncation is an obvious cause of the history-only gap, because it removes the text that these values match.
But it cannot be the only cause.
On FCRB nothing is cut, the default is written in the schema the judge reads, and correct defaults still carry the largest gap of any path.
A judge might reasonably hesitate over a default that the user never mentioned.
Yet base rates do not explain this gap.
This suggests a second explanation besides missing information: the input has no explicit reference, that is, no text that states what the value should be.
Section 3.4 examines both explanations with controlled tests.
blocks.zh:
截断不是整个故事。 在CFB上,截取是造成历史唯一漏洞的明显原因,因为它删除了这些值相匹配的文本.
但这不是唯一的原因。
在FCRB上,任何内容都不要被剪切,默认都写在法官读取的策略中,正确的默认仍然带有任何路径的最大缺口.
法官可能有理由对用户从未提及的违约情况犹豫不决。
然而,基准费率并不能解释这一差距。
这说明除了缺少信息之外还有第二个解释:输入没有明确提及,即没有文字说明数值应该是什么.
第3.4节用有控制的测试来审查这两种解释。

blocks.en: 3.4 Judges Follow the Reference
blocks.zh: 3.4 法官参考

blocks.en: Figure 2: (a) Argument AUROC on FCRB-Relocate, with the source of the correct value in view (visible) or past the cut (buried). CLM is run at its default input length of 2,048 tokens and is not given the full history. (b) Acceptance at τ \tau of the 142 correct FCRB defaults whose DeRef reference says the default applies. Schema facts restates the default and lists related words in the request. Error bars show 95% CIs.
blocks.zh: 图2: (a) 关于FCRB-重排的参数AUROC,以查看(可见)或过切(被接)的正确值取出源. CLM以2,048个符的默认输入长度运行,没有获得完整的历史. (b) 在\tau接受142项正确的FCRB缺省,其参考文献称缺省适用。 Schema 事实重述默认,并在请求中列出相干词. 出错栏显示95% CI.

blocks.en:
Two explanations remain for a rejected correct value.
The judge may lack the information.
Or it may have the information but no explicit reference.
The tests below examine these two explanations.
They use the four judges named in Section 3.2 .
blocks.zh:
对被拒绝的正确价值仍有两种解释。
法官可能缺乏信息。
或者它可能拥有信息,但没有明确提及。
以下的测试考察了这两种解释.
他们使用第3.2节指定的四名法官。

blocks.en:
Test 1: judges prefer visible distractors when sources are hidden. If a judge merely lacked information, hiding the source should push its score toward uncertainty.
Instead it follows the wrong value it can see.
We build FCRB-Relocate from 257 FCRB states.
We move the value of one argument from the user request into the return of an added earlier call.
The request now points to the right entry by one of its attributes.
The return lists eight entries, the correct one and seven distractors whose values come from other FCRB samples.
Each state has two versions that differ only in the order of the entries.
The correct entry comes second, within the first 1,000 characters that the judge sees, or last, past that cut.
The first distractor stays in view in both versions.
This mirrors how history-only values arise in CFB (Appendix A ).
Burying the source drops argument AUROC from between 91.89 and 99.88 to between 39.80 and 49.03 for all four judges (Figure 2 a).
Against the distractor in view alone, AUROC is between 26.71 and 39.88, so all four judges rank the wrong value they can see above the correct value that was cut.
Given the full history, Jev, Qwen3-8B, and Qwen3.8-27B recover, to between 98.39 and 99.86.
blocks.zh:
测试一:当来源被隐藏时,法官更喜欢可见分光器. 如果法官只是缺乏信息,隐藏消息来源应将其得分推向不确定性。
相反,它遵循的是它可以看到的错误价值。
我们从257个FCRB州建造了FCRB - 重新定位.
我们从用户请求中移出一个参数的价值,返回一个先前添加的呼叫。
请求现在以其一个属性指向正确的条目.
返回列出了8个条目,正确的1个和7个分心器,其数值取自其他FCRB样本.
每个州有两个版本,只按条目顺序不同.
正确的条目第二,在法官看到或最后看到的第一个1000个字符中,通过剪接。
第一个分心者在两个版本中都保持视线.
这反映了在CFB(Appendix A.)中只产生历史值的方式.
将所有四名法官的AUROC的论据从91.89至99.88降至39.80至49.03(图2a)。
仅针对分散视线者,AUROC在26.71到39.88之间,因此所有4位法官都将他们可以看到的错值排在被削减的正确值上方.
鉴于全史,Jev,Quen3-8B,和Quen3.8-27B恢复到98.39-99.86之间.

blocks.en:
Test 2: restoring the information closes the gap only where a source was cut. If truncation were the whole cause, the uncut history should close the gap on every path.
We give Jev, Qwen3-8B, and Qwen3.8-27B the full history, with returns uncut and no window, up to each judge’s input limit (Appendix A ).
On CFB, this narrows the gap on history-only values by between 37.50 and 62.84 points, and for Qwen3.8-27B the remaining gap is no longer significant (Table 17 in Appendix H ).
Argument AUROC on these values rises by between 11.45 and 25.95 points.
But on no-source values it raises AUROC for none of the three judges, and it lowers it for Jev by 2.83 points and for Qwen3-8B by 13.83 points (Table 18 in Appendix H ).
Putting back only the one cut step that holds the source has the same effect on FinTrace: it raises the scores of correct history-only values for all four judges, against a placebo step of the same kind (Appendix A ).
A reference also helps on top of the uncut history (Section 5.3 ).
blocks.zh:
测试2:只有当源被剪除时,才恢复信息来弥补缺口. 如果截断是整个原因,未截断的历史应该能弥合每条道路上的差距.
我们给Jev, Quen3 -8B, 和Quen3. 8 -27B 完整历史,且返回未切除且没有窗口,以达到每个法官的输入限制(附录A )。
在CFB上,这缩小了仅历史值的差距,在37.50到62.84分之间,对于Qune3.8-27B来说. 其余差距不再显著(附录H表17)。
关于这些值的参数AUROC上升了11.45至25.95分.
但是,在无源值上,它使AUROC对三个法官中没有一个提高,对Jev则降低2.83分,对Qune3-8B则降低13.83分(附录H中表18.
倒放只握住源的一个剪接步骤对FinTrace有同样的效果:它提高了所有四位裁判的正确历史唯一值的分数,对同一种安慰剂步骤(Appendix A.
在未剪接的历史上,参考也有所帮助(第5.3节)。

blocks.en:
Test 3: the information can be in view and still not count. In FCRB the default is written in the parameter description that the judge sees, and nothing is cut, yet judges accept correct defaults less often than correct values in view (Table 1 ).
On the 142 of the 185 correct defaults whose DeRef reference (Section 4 ) says that the default applies, a line that restates the schema default and lists which related words appear in the request changes acceptance by at most 6.18 points.
The reference itself, which writes out this derivation, raises it to between 73.02 and 88.06 (Figure 2 b).
This subset is chosen by the reference.
Table 17 in Appendix H reports all 185, with the same picture.
blocks.zh:
测试3:信息可以被查看,仍然不计. 在FCRB中,默认写在法官看到的参数描述中,没有被剪切,然而法官接受正确默认的频率低于所查看的正确值(表1).
在185项正确的默认中,有142项的DeRef参考(第4节)说,默认适用,该行重复了计划默认,并列出了请求中出现的相关单词,最多可更改6.18分的接受。
参考本身写出这一推论,将其提高到73.02至88.06之间(图2b)。
此子集由引用选择 。
附录中的表17 H报告全部185,图片相同.

blocks.en:
A matching reference lifts wrong values too. The three tests say that judges need a reference.
The last test shows that judges follow a reference even when it supports a wrong value.
On CFB, we add snippets from the full history around each place where the candidate value occurs, built by the snippet rule of Appendix G .
Such snippets contain the value by construction, so they agree with any candidate.
On the 59 wrong history-only arguments, they raise the mean score for all four judges, by between 14.28 and 39.39 points.
At the 0.5 decision threshold, CLM, Jev, and Qwen3-8B then accept between 28 and 49 of the 59, while Qwen3.8-27B accepts 2.
On FinTrace-HC, which pairs for the same argument a wrong value that appeared earlier in the history (H) with one that did not (C), CLM, Jev, and Qwen3-8B score H higher than C (Appendices A and G ).
blocks.zh:
匹配的引用也会抬出错误的值 。 三种考证说法官需要参考.
上个测试显示,即使支持错误的值,法官也会遵循引用.
在CFB上,我们添加来自每个候选值发生地的完整历史的片段,由附录G的片段规则所构建.
这种片段包含建筑价值,因此他们同意任何候选人的意见.
在59个错误的仅以历史为主的论据上,他们将所有4名裁判的平均分提高14.28分至39.39分.
在0.5决定阈值下,CLM,Jev,和Qune3-8B随后接受59个中28个到49个,而Qune3.8-27B接受2个.
在FinTrace-HC上,它为同一论点配对了一个在历史(H)上早期出现的错误值与一个没有(C),CLM,Jev,和Qune3-8B的分数H比C(附录A和G.)高.

blocks.en:
These tests show one pattern.
A judge scores a value higher when a reference in its input matches it, whether the value is right or wrong.
It does not reliably rebuild the derivation on its own, even from the full history.
blocks.zh:
这些测试显示了一种模式。
当一个输入中的引用与其匹配时,无论该数值是正确还是错误,法官的评分都更高.
它不能可靠地自己重建衍生物,即使是从整个历史中衍生出物。

blocks.en: 4 DeRef : Deriving the Reference
blocks.zh: 4 参考文献: 引出参考文献

blocks.en:
DeRef gives the judge a reference that is ready to use.
It has two steps (Figure 1 b).
A deriver model reads the full history H H and the schema, with returns uncut and no window (Appendix F ).
The deriver sees the function called at the step under judgment and its schema, but no candidate value.
For each argument it writes the expected value and its source.
If the history does not fix the value, it says so, and that statement becomes the reference.
Our deriver reads everything, so it can name values whose source was cut from the judge input (Section 5.3 ).
Because the deriver never sees the candidate, the reference cannot echo the value under test.
The deriver writes one reference per argument of a state, and all candidates at that state share it.
We use Qwen3.8-27B ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) as the deriver for every judge, with thinking on (Appendix G gives the prompt and Appendix F the settings).
We insert the reference into the judge input, after the history and before the function description.
The judge itself is unchanged and scores each argument as before.
In all main experiments, every judge keeps its usual truncated input and reads the reference in addition (Appendix A ).
blocks.zh:
DeRef为法官提供了可供使用的参考文献。
它有两个步骤(图1b)。
一个衍生模型读取了完整的历史 H 和 schema, 返回不剪接, 没有窗口 (Appendix F. ).
推论者认为,这一职能在判断的步骤及其计划之下是需要的,但没有候选人的价值。
它为每个论点写出预期值及其来源。
如果历史没有固定这个值,它就这样说了,这个声明就成为了参考.
我们的推导者阅读了一切,因此它可以列出其来源从法官输入中被切断的值(第5.3节)。
由于衍生者从未见过候选人,因此引用不能与所测试的值相呼应.
推论者每个州的论点都写出一个参考,该州的所有候选人都分享.
我们使用Quen3.8-27B (Quen Team, 2026)作为每个裁判的发端人,思考(附录G给出了快速和附录F的设置).
在法官的投入中,在历史和函数描述之后插入参考。
法官本身没有改变,每条论据都与以前一样。
在所有主要实验中,每个判断者都保留了通常的截取输入并阅读附加参考(附录A.

blocks.en: 5 Experiments
blocks.zh: 5个实验

blocks.en: We ask whether DeRef improves every judge and how it compares with prior ways to give the judge evidence (RQ1) , where the gains come from (RQ2) , and whether the reference drives the judgment (RQ3) .
blocks.zh: 我们询问DeRef是否改进了每个法官,它如何与先前向法官提供证据的方法(RQ1)进行比较,从何处获得收益(RQ2),以及参考是否推动判决(RQ3).

blocks.en: 5.1 Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 设置

blocks.en:
We use the three benchmarks of Section 3.2 and the two controlled sets (Section 3.4 and Appendix A ).
Our main experiments run DeRef with four of the seven judges: CLM, Jev, Qwen3-8B, and Qwen3.8-27B.
Qwen3-8B is the frozen backbone of CLM, so the two share one base model.
Qwen3.8-27B is the largest open LLM we run.
blocks.zh:
我们使用第3.2节的三项基准和两套控制下的基准(第3.4节和附录A)。
我们的主要实验用7位评委中的4位进行DeRef运行:CLM,Jev,Qune3-8B,和Qune3.8-27B.
Quen3-8B是CLM的被冻结的骨干,所以两个共享一个基模型.
Quen3.8-27B是我们运行的最大开放LLM.

blocks.en:
Inputs. Plain is the truncated input of Section 3.2 .
We compare DeRef with three prior methods (Appendix G ).
ProvenanceGuard evidence gives the judge snippets of the history that a model quotes as the source of the proposed value ( She et al., 2026 ) .
RevisEval gives the judge a revised version of the proposed call ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) .
Both use Qwen3.8-27B with the same settings as our deriver, and both see the proposed value.
Self-generated reference has the judge model write the expected value from its own truncated input before it judges ( Zeng et al., 2024 ) .
It needs a judge that writes text, so it runs with Qwen3-8B and Qwen3.8-27B.
Full history has no window and no cut, up to about 32K tokens (FCRB has no cut).
We run it with Jev and the two LLM judges. We report argument AUROC and Gap τ \mathrm{Gap}_{\tau} with τ \tau set again for each input. Appendix E gives call-level AUROC.

5.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 5.2 主要成果

blocks.en:
DeRef improves every judge. Table 2 answers RQ1.
It covers four judges and three benchmarks, that is, 12 pairs of judge and benchmark. DeRef raises argument AUROC over Plain in all 12 pairs, by between 1.44 and 22.14 points, and every gain is significant (Table 16 in Appendix H ).
The Llama and Mistral judges gain between 8.78 and 20.84 points, also significantly (Table 14 in Appendix G ).
The gains carry over to call-level AUROC, where all 12 are again significant (Appendix E ).
blocks.zh:
DeRef 改进每个法官。 表2对RQ1.
它包括4名法官和3个基准,即12对法官和基准。 De Refer 提出所有12对平原的AUROC论点,在1.44至22.14分之间,每个增益都是重大的(附录H表16)。
Llama和Mistral法官的得分在8.78至20.84之间,也有很大的提高(附录G表14)。
收益将转至呼叫级AUROC,其中所有12个都再次具有重大意义(附录E)。

blocks.en:
Comparison with prior methods. RevisEval is the strongest prior method in all 12 pairs. DeRef is above it in 10 pairs and significantly above it in 8.
Averaged over the four judges, DeRef is significantly above RevisEval on every benchmark (Appendix H ).
In the other two pairs, Qwen3.8-27B on FCRB and FinTrace, RevisEval is higher by 0.32 and 0.27 points, and neither is significant. DeRef is significantly above ProvenanceGuard evidence in all 12 pairs.
Self-generated reference gains at most 3.01 points over Plain and stays below DeRef in all six pairs where it runs.
blocks.zh:
与以往方法的比较。 重试 Eval是所有12对中最强的前置方法. DeRef在10对上方,在8对上方显著.
平均在四名法官中,De Ref在每一基准(附录H)上都大大高于RevisEval。
在另外两对,即FCRB和FinTrace上的Qune3.8-27B上,RevisEval的分数分别上升了0.32分和0.27分,两者都不显著. DeRef在全部12对中都显著地高于"证据指南"的证据.
在平原之上最多3.01分的自产生参考增益,并在运行的所有6对参考物中停留在DeRef下.

blocks.en:
More context and more reasoning. Giving the judge the full history instead of a reference is significantly below DeRef (Table 2 ).
Averaged over the three judges that are given it, the difference is 11.58 points on CFB and 4.35 on FinTrace (Appendix H ).
More reasoning by the judge does not make up for the reference either.
Qwen3.8-27B judging directly with thinking on stays below the same model reading the reference with thinking off on all three benchmarks, by between 2.82 and 10.92 points (Appendix G ).
blocks.zh:
更多背景和更多的推理. 给予法官完整的历史而不是参考文献大大低于参考文献(表2)。
平均而言,给予它的三名法官的差别是CFB的11.58分和FinTrace的4.35分(附录H.).
法官更多的推理也不足以补充参考。
Quen3.8-27 (中文(简体) ). B 直接判断,如果考虑留在同一个模型以下,读取参考,然后考虑所有三个基准,从2.82分到10.92分(附录G.)。

blocks.en:
Controlled sets. On the buried version of FCRB-Relocate, where all four judges fell to chance or below (Section 3.4 ), DeRef brings them back to between 98.40 and 99.59 (Figure 2 a).
This includes CLM, which is not given the full history.
On the visible version and on FinTrace-HC, where the judges were already accurate, DeRef makes no judge significantly worse (Table 6 in Appendix A ).
blocks.zh:
控制装置。 关于埋葬的FCRB-Relocate版本,所有四名法官都陷入或低于机会(第3.4节),DeRef使他们回到98.40至99.59之间(图2a)。
其中包括没有获得完整历史的CLM.
在明显版本和FinTrace-HC(法官已经准确)上,DeRef没有使法官大为糟糕(附录A表6)。

Table 3 removes one part of DeRef at a time.
We show CFB with Qwen3.8-27B because CFB has the largest gap on a single path and includes sources that were cut from the judge input.
Every drop is significant, and the largest comes from writing the reference from the judge’s cut input instead of the full history.
blocks.zh:
表3一次删除DeRef的一部份。
我们用Quen3.8-27B显示 CFB 因为CFB在单一路径上差距最大,并且包括从法官输入中被切断的源.
每下降一次都是显著的,最大的一次来自从法官的切入输入来写出参考文献而不是完整的历史.

blocks.en:
Why keep the judge. Keeping only the parsed expected value costs little where the reference states a value (1.39 points) and much where the parser finds none (22.37 points), so the text beyond the stated value helps mainly where it still carries the value (Appendix D ).
This is also why we keep the judge instead of matching the candidate against the parsed value: where the parser finds no value, a string match has nothing to compare, and the judge still uses the rest of the reference.
blocks.zh:
为甚么却留法官. 仅保留已解析的预期值成本很少,如果参考文献显示值(1.39分),而很多分析者发现无值(22.37分),所以超出所声明值的文本主要帮助它仍然带有值(附录D.)的地方.
这也是为什么我们保留法官,而不是将候选人与解析值相匹配:解析器发现没有值时,字符串匹配没有任何可比较之处,法官仍然使用其余的参考.

blocks.en:
Reference or more thinking. Table 4 crosses the reference with judge thinking, with the full history in all four settings.
The best setting is the reference with thinking off, at 96.01.
So the gain comes from the reference, not from more reasoning by the judge.
blocks.zh:
参考或多想. 表4用法官的思维来交叉参考,在所有四个场合都有完整的历史.
最好的环境是96.01的参考文献
因此收益来自参考,而不是法官的更多推理.

blocks.en:
Why hide the candidate. A deriver that sees the candidate, DeRef -v, is above DeRef on CFB and below it on FCRB and FinTrace, and it names the wrong value under test as the expected value up to six times as often (Appendix G ).
We therefore keep the deriver that does not see the value.

何以藏所选者. 一个看到候选人DeRef -v的衍生者在CFB上方是DeRef,在FCRB和FinTrace上下方是DeRef,它将测试中的错误值命名为预期值的六倍多(附录G.
因此,我们保留没有看到价值的衍生者。

blocks.en: 5.4 Changing the Reference Changes the Judgment
blocks.zh: 5.4 (中文(简体) ). 更改引用更改判决

blocks.en: Figure 3: Changing one value in the reference. Dots show the original reference, which names the correct value. Arrow heads show it with a wrong value from the same state.
blocks.zh: 图3:改变参考文献中的一个数值。 Dots 显示原始的引用,它命名了正确的值. 箭头以同一状态出错的值显示.

blocks.en:
We now test whether judges follow the DeRef reference itself.
We take up to 500 arguments per benchmark whose reference names the correct value (332 on CFB, 417 on FCRB, and 500 on FinTrace).
In the reference text, we replace that value with a wrong value for the same argument from the same state and keep all other text.
On CFB and FCRB, where the wrong values come from real models, all four judges follow the change (Figure 3 ).
At the 0.5 threshold, acceptance of correct values drops by between 15.36 and 57.07 points, and acceptance of wrong values rises by between 20.38 and 57.79 points.
Argument AUROC falls from between 92.16 and 99.91 to between 42.63 and 77.92.
All 24 changes are significant.
The swap also overturns judgments that agreed with the labels under Plain.
For correct values that a judge accepted with Plain input, acceptance drops by between 10.85 and 53.62 points.
For values labeled wrong that it rejected, acceptance rises by between 11.00 and 50.74 points.
FinTrace behaves differently, because we made its wrong values by rule, and under Plain the judges accept at most 11.44% of them at 0.5.
After the swap, their acceptance rises by at most 20.20 points, and AUROC stays between 80.26 and 99.77.
Still, CLM, Qwen3-8B, and Qwen3.8-27B lower their acceptance of correct values by between 26.40 and 73.20 points, and Jev by 3.00 points.
Since the reference is the only text we change, the change in judgment comes from the reference (examples in Appendix J ).
blocks.zh:
我们现在检验法官是否遵循《参考文献》本身。
每个基准的参考名称为正确值的参数最多为500个(CFB为332个,FCRB为417个,FinTrace为500个)。
在参考文本中,我们用错误的数值取代同一国家提出的相同论点,并保留所有其他文本。
在CFB和FCRB上,错误的值来自真实模型,这四个评委都跟随变化(图3.
在0.5阈值下,接受正确值下降15.36至57.07分,接受错误值上升20.38至57.79分.
参数AUROC从92.16到99.91,下降到42.63到77.92.
所有24个变化都是重大的。
互换还推翻了与平原公司标签一致的判决。
对于法官通过Plain输入接受的正确数值,接受值下降为10.85至53.62分.
对于标有错误的被它拒绝的值,接受值在11.00到50.74分之间上升.
FinTrace的行为不同,因为我们通过规则来做出错误的价值观,在平原下,评委最多以11.44%接受其中的0.5.
互换后,它们的接受量最多会上升20.20分,而AUROC则停留在80.26到99.77之间.
尽管如此,CLM,Qwen3-8B,和Quen3.8-27B将它们对正确值的接受度降低26.40到73.20分,而Jev则降低3.00分.
由于引用是我们唯一修改的文本,因此判决的变更来自引用(附录J中的例子).

blocks.en: Summary. RQ1: DeRef improves argument AUROC for every tested judge on every benchmark and significantly outperforms RevisEval when averaged over judges. RQ2: deriving a reference from the full history provides gains that more context or judge thinking alone does not achieve. RQ3: swapping the reference to name a wrong value can reverse judgments on CFB and FCRB.
blocks.zh: 总结. RQ1: De Reference改进了每个基准上每个被测试法官的论据AUROC,当平均比法官高时,RevisEval的绩效明显高于法官。 RQ2:从完整的历史中引出一个参考,可带来更多背景或法官单独思考无法实现的收益。 RQ3:将名称的引用互换出一个错误的值可以逆转对CFB和FCRB的判断.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
Argument judges tend to score the candidate against explicit reference values in their input.
When a correct value matches only a return that was cut, or is a default with nothing saying that it applies, the input holds no such reference, and judges of every type and size we test accept it less often than a value shown in the input.
On the two multi-step benchmarks, the same holds for values that match no span of the history. DeRef derives the reference from the full history before the candidate is seen.
Providing this reference improves overall argument AUROC for all six judges we test on three benchmarks, with no change to the judges, and substantially reduces the gap on cut returns and on defaults.
blocks.zh:
辩论法官往往在投入中根据明确的参考值对候选人进行评分。
当一个正确的值只匹配被剪切的返回,或者是一个默认但无任何说明其应用的默认时,输入没有这样的引用,而我们测试的每一种类型和大小的判断都比输入中显示的数值少一些接受.
在两个多步骤的基准上,与历史不相匹配的价值观也同样如此。 De Reference从候选人被看到之前的全部历史中得出参考。
提供这一参考,可以改进我们测试的三个基准的所有六名法官的总体论点,对法官不作任何修改,并大大减少削减回报和缺省方面的差距。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Each argument has one gold value in our data, so a reference that names it can lead judges to reject another value that is also correct (Appendix A ). On CFB and FinTrace, the wrong labels come from our own construction, and an audit of 100 items per dataset by two annotators could not confirm 3% and 4% of them. Appendix A runs a worst-case analysis of this label uncertainty, and every gain of DeRef over Plain remains significant. FCRB labels follow the official BFCL checker and are not independently audited.
blocks.zh: 每一个论点在我们的数据中都有一个黄金值,因此一个可以导致法官拒绝另一个同样正确的值的引用(附录A. 在CFB和FinTrace上,错误的标签来自我们自己的构造,两个注释员对每个数据集100个项目的审计无法确认其中的3%和4%. 附 录 对这个标签不确定性进行最坏情况分析,DeRef over Plain的每个收益都仍然很大。 FCRB标签遵循官方BFCL检查器,不独立审计.

blocks.en: On FinTrace, DeRef does not shrink the gap on no-source values for three of four judges (Table 17 ). The low base rate of this path may account for part of that gap (Section 3.3 ).
blocks.zh: 关于FinTrace,DeRef没有缩小四名法官中有三名法官在无源值方面的差距(表17)。 这一路径的低基率可能构成这一差距的一部分(第3.3节)。

blocks.en: Main results use one deriver model, Qwen3.8-27B, held fixed across judges and input conditions. In the ablation (Table 3 ), a weaker deriver, Qwen3-8B, still improves Qwen3.8-27B’s argument AUROC over Plain on CFB. Broader evaluation of derivers from other model families is left to future work.
blocks.zh: 主要成果使用一种衍生模型 -- -- Qune3.8-27B,该模型固定在法官和投入条件之间。 在通缩(表3)中,较弱的衍生物Quen3-8B仍然改进了Qwen3.8-27B在CFB上对平原的AUROC的论点. 对来自其他模范家庭的衍生者进行更广泛的评价留待未来工作。

blocks.en: Our judges include dedicated scoring models (CLM and Jev) and open LLMs of up to 27B parameters, which show the pattern across judge types and sizes. Evaluation on general-purpose frontier LLMs as judges is left to future work.
blocks.zh: 我们的法官包括专用评分模型(CLM和Jev)和最多27B个参数的开放式LLMS,它们显示了法官类型和大小的图案. 对作为法官的通用前沿法学硕士的评价留给今后的工作。

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en:
We use three public benchmarks as released, together with public trajectories of agent runs on ComplexFuncBench.
Their requests ask for function calls in tasks such as travel booking and financial queries, and their tool returns hold data such as hotel listings and company financials.
We do not collect new data from people, and we do not try to identify anyone.
Names in the requests come from the benchmarks, and we add no personal information.
Two authors checked samples of labels and paths by hand, and we used no crowd workers.
Jev, which we reach through an outside API, receives only benchmark text and model outputs.
blocks.zh:
我们使用三种公开基准 以及ComplexFunc Bench上的代理商的公开路线
他们的要求要求在诸如旅行预订和财务查询等任务中调用功能,其工具的返回持有酒店上市和公司财务等数据.
我们不从人们那里收集新数据,也不试图识别任何人。
请求中的名字来自基准,我们没有增加个人信息。
两位作者亲手检查了标签和路径的样本,我们没有使用人群工人.
我们通过外部API接触的Jev只收到基准文本和模型输出.

blocks.en:
Argument judges can gate tool calls that have real effects, such as a booking or a trade.
Our results show that judges follow the reference in their input, and the swap test shows that a wrong reference overturns many judgments.
So a deriver that errs, or a tool return written to mislead it, could make a judge accept a wrong argument.
We therefore see DeRef as support for review, not a replacement for it.
Calls with high stakes should still go to a person or to a check that does not rely on the judge.
We recommend keeping each derived reference with its scores, so that a reviewer can see why a value was accepted.
blocks.zh:
辩证法官可以开出有实际效果的工具电话,如预订或交易.
我们的结果显示,法官们在投入中遵循参考,而互换测试显示,错误的参考推翻了许多判断.
因此,一个错误的推论者,或者一个为误导它而写作的工具返回,可以使法官接受一个错误的论点.
因此,我们认为《参考文件》支持审查,而不是取而代之。
有重大利害关系的电话仍应交给一个人,或交给不依赖法官的支票。
我们建议在评分中保留每个推算的参考值,以便审查者能够了解为什么某一数值被接受。

blocks.en:
The benchmarks are task-oriented, and their texts are function requests, schemas, and tool returns.
We did not see offensive content in the items we read for our label and path checks.
We did not screen every item, and we use the texts as released.
blocks.zh:
这些基准以任务为导向,其文本是函数请求、计划和工具返回。
我们没有看到我们阅读的标签和路径检查项目中带有冒犯性的内容。
我们没有筛选每一个项目,我们使用已发布的文本。

blocks.en: Appendix A Data and Judge Inputs
blocks.zh: 附录A 数据和法官投入

blocks.en:
We need three things: multi-step trajectories with real tool returns, so that sources can be cut, a gold value for each argument, and wrong calls made by real models.
TRBench_BFCL uses the same BFCL tasks as FCRB in its single-turn part and compares whole turns of calls in its multi-turn part ( Li et al., 2026b ) .
The data of ProvenanceGuard label calls for safety or judge tasks by their final outcome, so they give no gold value per argument ( She et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
我们需要三件事: 具有真实工具返回的多步轨道, 这样源可以被剪去, 每个参数的黄金值, 以及真实模型错误的调用。
TR Bench_ BFCL (英语). 单转部分使用与FCRB相同的BFCL任务,并比较多转部分(Li等,2026b.
ProvenanceGuard标签的数据要求安全性或判断任务最终结果,因此没有给出每个论据的黄金值(She等,2026).

blocks.en:
From the 1,500 single-turn requests of FC-RewardBench we drop the 15 with unparseable wrong outputs.
We keep the 650 whose wrong call fails the value check of BFCL (error type value_error ).
We then remove 20 whose only recorded message is a system prompt.
We check each argument of the wrong call on its own with the BFCL checker.
It is labeled wrong when the checker rejects its value and carries no label otherwise.
This leaves 630 requests, each with one correct and one wrong call, and 1,719 correct and 769 wrong argument values.
FCRB has no earlier calls, so the judge sees the request only.
blocks.zh:
从FC-Reward Bench的1500个单回合请求中,我们放弃了15个无法解析的错误输出.
我们保留了650个错误的呼叫失败 BFCL (错误类型值_error ) 的值检查 。
然后,我们删除20个 唯一录制的信息是系统提示。
我们用BFCL的检查器 自己检查每个错误呼叫的论据
如果检查器拒绝其值,且没有标签,则标签错误。
这就留下了630个请求,每个请求都有一个正确和错误的呼叫,还有1,719个正确和769个错误的参数值.
FCRB没有更早的电话,因此法官只看请求.

blocks.en:
We use the released trajectories of 30 models on the 1,000 CFB tasks (revision fcc906da ).
For each trajectory we find the first step where the model call differs from the gold call.
We keep the divergences in which the model calls the gold function with different argument values, since only these give an argument to label; a call to another function or a missing call is left out.
The gold history up to that step is the state.
The gold call is the correct call and the model call is the wrong call.
Models that make the same wrong call at a state are counted once, so a state can carry several wrong calls.
Parallel calls are matched to gold calls by position.
We drop 30 wrong argument values whose parallel calls to the same function could not be matched in order.
This leaves 347 correct and 644 wrong calls, with 1,639 correct and 999 wrong argument values.
blocks.zh:
我们在1000个CFB任务(revision fcc906da.)上使用30个模型的已放出轨迹.
对于每个轨迹,我们发现第一步 模型调用与黄金调用不同。
我们保留模型调用有不同参数值的金函数的相差之处,因为只有这些函数给出了标签的参数;一个函数的调用或一个缺失的调用被忽略了.
黄金历史直到那一步是州.
金通是正确调用,而模型调用则是错误调用.
在一个状态下发出同样错误呼叫的模型被计算一次,因此一个状态可以携带几个错误的呼叫.
平行的呼叫按位置与黄金呼叫相匹配.
我们删除了30个错误的参数值,这些参数的并行调用无法按顺序匹配同一函数。
这就留下了347个正确和644个错误的电话,其中有1,639个正确和999个错误的论证值.

blocks.en:
FinTrace gives 800 test queries with golden trajectories ( Cao et al., 2026 ) . It labels whole trajectories but no wrong calls at the argument level.
We make wrong calls from golden calls by rule, with a fixed seed (20260930).
Each wrong call keeps the endpoint and changes one argument.
A ticker becomes a ticker used in another query, a date or year moves by one to three years (a from and to pair moves together), or the reporting period switches between annual and quarter.
We keep calls whose function descriptions come from the documentation of the data provider, and we drop 10 calls whose request has an unfilled template.
This leaves 2,334 correct and 2,334 wrong calls, with 7,428 correct and 2,796 wrong argument values.
blocks.zh:
FinTrace提供了800个带有黄金轨迹的测试查询(Cao等,2026.). 它标注了整个轨迹, 但是在参数级别上没有错误的调用 。
我们按规矩从金色的召唤中发出错误的呼叫,有固定的种子(20260930).
每个错误的呼叫都保留了终点并更改了一个参数.
滴答器变成另一个查询中使用的滴答器,一个日期或年份移动一至三年(一个从一到对移动在一起),或者报告期在年度和季度之间切换.
我们保留来自数据提供者文档的功能描述的电话,我们放弃了10个请求有未填入模板的电话。
这就留下了2,334个正确和2,334个错误的电话,其中7,428个正确和2,796个错误的参数值.

blocks.en:
Two annotators independently checked 100 random arguments labeled wrong from each of CFB and FinTrace, without seeing any judge score or derived reference.
They agreed on 94% of the CFB items and 88% of the FinTrace items, and settled the rest by discussion.
Of 100 CFB arguments, 97 were confirmed wrong, 2 could also be correct, and 1 was unclear.
Of 100 FinTrace arguments, 96 were confirmed wrong, 2 could also be correct, and 2 were unclear.
We checked CFB and FinTrace because their argument labels come from our construction procedures.
FCRB labels follow the official BFCL checker and were kept unchanged.
To bound the effect of these labels, we run a worst-case deletion (Table 5 ).
For each judge and dataset, we remove the share of wrong values that the audit could not confirm, 3% on CFB and 4% on FinTrace, choosing the values whose removal lowers the gain of DeRef over Plain the most.
This targets the way such noise favors DeRef : a reference that names the gold value leads the judge to reject a value that is labeled wrong but also correct, which counts as a correct rejection.
On both datasets, every judge keeps a significant gain, between 11.76 and 20.19 points on CFB and between 0.89 and 6.42 points on FinTrace.
We do not apply this test to the comparison with RevisEval, since its revised call also names the gold value, so the two methods share this effect and a deletion chosen against one of them would not model label noise.
The derivation gap and τ \tau use only correct arguments, so these negative-label ambiguities do not affect Table 1 .
blocks.zh:
两位注释员独立地检查了CFB和FinTrace各标出错误的100个随机参数,没有看到任何评分或衍生出参考.
他们同意了94%的CFB项目和88%的FinTrace项目,并通过讨论解决了其余项目.
在100个CFB论点中,97个被确认错误,2个也可能正确,1个不清楚.
在FinTrace的100个论点中,96个被确认是错误的,2个也可能是正确的,2个不明确.
我们检查了CFB和FinTrace 因为他们的论证标签来自我们的施工程序.
FCRB标签沿用了官方的BFCL检查器并保持不变.
为了约束这些标签的效果,我们运行一个最坏的删除(表5).
对于每个评委和数据集,我们删除了审计无法确认的错误值份额,在CFB和FinTrace上分别占3%和4%,选择删除后最会降低DeRef对Plain收益的值.
这以这种噪音偏向DeReference的方式为目标:一种将黄金值命名的引用会导致法官拒绝一个被贴上错误标签但也正确的数值,这算作正确的拒绝.
在两个数据集上,每个评委都保持了显著的增益,CFB的分数在11.76到20.19分之间,FinTrace的分数在0.89到6.42分之间.
我们并不将这个测试应用于与RevisEval的比较,因为其修改后的调用也命名了黄金值,因此两种方法都分享了这个效果,并且对其中之一选择的删除不会给标签噪声做模型.
引出缺口和\tau只使用正确的参数,因此这些负标签模糊不影响表1。

blocks.en: Table 5: Worst-case deletion of unconfirmed wrong labels. Full is the gain of DeRef over Plain in argument AUROC (points) on all wrong values. Worst case removes, for each judge, the 3% of CFB wrong values and 4% of FinTrace wrong values whose removal lowers that gain the most, and reports the gain that remains, with its 95% CI below. FCRB labels follow the BFCL checker and are not audited.
blocks.zh: 表5:最坏情况:删除未经证实的错误标签。 De Refer over Plain 在所有错误值上争论 AUROC(点数) 的收获是完全的。 最坏的情况是,对每个法官来说,取消3%的CFB错误值和4%的FinTracs错误值,这些错误值的去除会降低收益,并报告剩余收益,其95%的CI低于。 FCRB的标签遵循BFCL检查器,不进行审计.

blocks.en:
Every judge reads the same text (Figure 4 ).
The state gives the request and the most recent earlier calls with their returns.
CFB shows the last 3 steps and FinTrace the last 5 calls of earlier turns.
Each return is cut to its first 1,000 characters.
If the longest CLM input of a state is still above 2,048 tokens, we drop the returns of the earliest shown step, then whole early steps, and last the middle of the request, keeping at least 40 tokens of it.
A state that is still too long is left out.
Correct and wrong calls at a state share the state text.
After the state come the function line, the parameter line, and the proposed value.
On FCRB the parameter line adds the type, the enum, and the default of the schema.
On CFB it adds the enum, and on FinTrace it adds nothing.
The question to the judge is “Is this the correct value for this parameter, given the question?”
CLM is CLM-v0.1-8B.
We call Jev through OpenRouter with the version id typesafe/jev-1.13-20260917 , and we check that every reply returns this id.
When we ask Jev again on 500 random inputs, 497 answers fall on the same side of 0.5 as before, and scores differ by at most 0.17.
blocks.zh:
每个法官都读同文(图4).
国家提出这一要求,最近又发出回电。
CFB显示最后3个步骤和FinTracing前5个回合的后5个呼叫.
每回被切入到它的前1000个字符.
如果一个状态中最长的 CLM 输入仍然超过 2,048 个令牌, 我们放弃了最早显示步骤的返回, 然后是整个早期步骤, 最后是请求的中间, 保留至少 40个令牌 。
一个仍然太长的州被排除在外。
一个州的对错呼叫共享州的文本.
在状态出现之后,函数行,参数行,以及拟议值.
在FCRB上,参数行会添加类型,enum,以及schema的默认.
在CFB上,它添加了enum,在FinTrace上,它没有添加.
法官要问的问题是,“考虑到这个问题,这是这一参数的正确价值吗? “
CLM为CLM-v0.1-8B.
我们通过 OpenRouter 给 Jev 打电话,使用 id typesafe/jev-1.13-20260917 的版本,我们检查每个回复都返回这个id.
当我们再次问捷夫500个随机输入时,497个答案和以前一样倒在了0.5的同一边,得分最多0.17分.

blocks.en:
The reference goes after the state under the header “Expected value (written before seeing the proposed value):”.
If the state with this block exceeds 2,048 CLM tokens, the state takes further steps of the same ladder from its own level.
This removes more early history for 131 of the 2,638 CFB arguments (39 states) and 786 of the 10,224 FinTrace arguments (194 states).
All four judges read the same DeRef input.
blocks.zh:
在标题“预计值(在看到拟议值之前写出)”下,参考语句放在状态后:”
如果拥有此块的状态超过2,048 CLM 令牌,则该州会从自己的级别采取同级阶梯的进一步步骤.
这消除了2,638个CFB参数(39个州)中的131个和10,224个FinTrace参数(194个州)中的786个更早的历史.
所有四位法官都读取了DeRef的同一份投入.

blocks.en:
The full-history input shows every earlier call and return, with no window and no cut.
On FinTrace, 248 of the 10,224 arguments have an input longer than 32,768 tokens for a Qwen judge.
For these we drop the oldest returns, and then the oldest steps if needed, until the input fits.
No CFB input needs this. DeRef + full adds the reference to this input and uses the same rule.
Jev accepts less text (Table 11 ).
For 104 FinTrace arguments with full history and 102 with DeRef + full, its input drops one to three more of the oldest returns by the same rule.
Every other Jev input equals the Qwen input.
Without these arguments, no difference that involves the full history changes sign, and AUROC differences move by at most 0.46 points.
blocks.zh:
完整的历史输入显示每一次更早的呼叫和回回,没有窗口和剪接.
在"FinTrace"上,10,224个论点中,有248个对Quen法官的输入超过32,768个信使.
对于这些,我们放弃了最古老的返回,然后是最古老的步骤,如果需要的话,直到输入适合为止。
CFB 输入不需要这个 。 DeRef + full 添加了该输入的引用并使用相同的规则.
Jev接受的案文较少(表11)。
对于104个有完整历史的FinTrace参数和102个有DeRef + full的FinTrace参数,它的输入会以相同的规则再减少一到三个最古老的返回.
每一个 Jev 输入等于 Quen 输入 。
没有这些论点,任何涉及完整历史变化的区别都会有符号,而AUROC的差别最多会移动0.46分.

blocks.en:
This set mirrors how history-only values arise in CFB: for 263 of its 279 correct history-only values (94.3%), the source return is in the judge input but cut before the value.
We start from FCRB correct values that appear in the request.
We move one such value into the return of an added earlier call, find_saved_items , a name that no FCRB function uses.
The request is rewritten to point to the right entry by an attribute that only this entry has.
The return lists eight entries.
One holds the correct value.
Seven distractors hold values of the same kind from other FCRB samples, taken first from the same parameter name, then from the same function, then from any parameter.
In the visible version the correct entry comes second.
In the buried version it comes last.
When the correct entry would still start before character 1,000, every entry in both versions gets the same filler note, repeated until the correct entry of the buried version starts after that point, so the two versions hold the same eight entries in a different order.
In the buried returns, the correct value starts between characters 1,009 and 1,201.
The first distractor (H) is in view in both versions and starts by character 33.
The wrong values are H for every state and, where one exists, a value that appears in no text of the state (C).
This gives 257 correct values and 428 wrong values (257 H and 171 C) per version.
We drop states in which a distractor equals the correct value after lower-casing and removing all characters other than letters and digits.
Code asserts every placement above.
On the buried version, AUROC of the correct value against H alone is 34.21 for CLM, 28.23 for Jev, 26.71 for Qwen3-8B, and 39.88 for Qwen3.8-27B.
With the full history, the buried version reaches 99.81 [99.65, 99.93] for Jev, 98.39 [97.54, 99.12] for Qwen3-8B, and 99.86 [99.65, 99.99] for Qwen3.8-27B, as high as DeRef (Table 6 ).
So this set shows that judges fail when the source is out of view, not that DeRef beats the full history.
In a check of 19 states, the rewritten request and the full return fix the correct value in all 19, and H is wrong in all 19.
Two of the 19 rewrites have wording problems that do not change the label.
blocks.zh:
此设定镜像 CFB 中仅出自历史值: 对于其279个正确的仅出自历史值中的263个(94.3%),源回被输入到判断器输入中,但在数值之前被剪切.
我们从请求中出现的FCRB正确值开始.
我们移动一个这样的值来返回先前添加的调用, find_saved_items, 这个名称没有FCRB 函数使用 。
请求被重写为通过只有此条目的属性来指向正确的条目.
复有八门.
人们持有正确的价值。
7个分流器持有来自其他FCRB样本的同类型值,先取自同参数名称,再取自同函数,再取自任何参数.
在可见版本中,正确的条目名列第二。
在被埋葬的版本中,它是最后的。
当正确的条目在字符1000之前仍然开始时,两个版本的每个条目都会得到相同的填字符,重复到被掩埋的版本的正确条目在该点之后开始,因此两个版本以不同的顺序持有相同的八个条目.
在被掩埋的返回中,正确的值从字符1,009到1,201开始.
第一个分心器(H)在两个版本中都能看到,并以33个字符开头.
错误的值是每个州的H值,如果存在H值,则这个值出现在该州的无文字(C)中.
这使得每个版本有257个正确值和428个错误值(257个H和171个C).
将一个分心器在下级和去除除字母和数字以外的所有字符后等于正确值的状态删除。
代码是上面的每一个位置。
在被掩埋的版本上,仅对H的正确值为CLM34.21,Jev28.23,Qune3-8B26.71,Qune3.8-27B39.88.
随着完整的历史,被掩埋的版本为Jev达到 99.81 [99.65, 99.93],98.39 [97.54, 99.12] 为Qune3-8B,99.86 [99.65, 99.99] 为Qune3.8-27B,与De Ref(表6.)一样高.
因此,这集显示,当来源被忽略时,法官会失败,而不是说DeRef击败了整个历史.
在19个州的检查中,重写请求和全部回还都确定了所有19个州的正确值,而H在所有19个州的正确值都是错误的.
19个重写中有两个有措辞问题,不能改变标签.

blocks.en:
We start from the 1,099 FinTrace wrong calls whose original values all appear in the request.
For the changed argument, H takes another value that the same key holds in an earlier call or return of the trajectory.
H must have the same JSON type as the correct value, must differ from it, and must not appear in the request.
Synonyms of the reporting period do not count as different.
H keeps the rest of the call and the state.
C is the rule-made wrong call of the same state, kept when all its changed values are on the No-source path.
We drop H values that the golden trajectory uses in a later call (35 of 172), and tickers of the same company as the correct ticker (15).
This leaves 122 H values, 72 history-only and 50 visible.
Table 6 compares the 122 correct values with them.
The paired H minus C test of Section 3.4 uses the 106 of these states that also have a C (51 queries).
In a check of 20 samples, all 20 changed values are wrong at their step.
blocks.zh:
我们从1,099 FinTraces错误的电话开始 其原始值都出现在请求中
对于已改变的论据,H具有同一密钥在更早的调用或返回轨迹时所持有的另一个价值.
H必须具有与正确值相同的JSON类型,必须与它不同,不得出现在请求中.
报告所述期间的同义词并不不同。
H保持其余通话和状态.
C是规则制成的同一状态的错误调用,当其所有已改变的值都在无源路径上时保留.
我们把黄金轨迹使用的H值降低到后来的呼叫中(172的35个),把同一公司的计分器降低到正确的计分器(15个)。
这使得122H值,72个历史值和50个可见值.
表6比较了122个正确数值。
第3.4节的配对H减C测试使用了其中106个也有C(51个查询)的状态.
在20个样本的检查中,所有20个被改变的值都在其步入错误.

blocks.en: Table 6: Argument AUROC (in points) on the two controlled sets. Δ \Delta is DeRef minus Plain, with its 95% CI below. No difference is significantly negative.

The test uses FinTrace correct history-only values whose first occurrence was lost from the window.
We exclude booleans, empty strings, and numbers of at most two characters.
We also exclude other numbers and strings of at most three characters, which can match by chance.
We keep the 167 values whose source step lies outside the window (130 states, 93 queries).
The reveal version inserts that step at its place in time.
A long return shows 1,000 characters centered on the value.
The placebo inserts another step of the same kind from outside the window of the same trajectory.
It does not contain the value and has the closest displayed length.
Both versions use the same header.
The revealed step is a return for 80 values, an earlier call of the agent for 82, and assistant text for 5.
Against the placebo, the source raises the mean score of correct values by between 6.30 and 14.29 points for all four judges, while wrong values in the same states move by at most 3.49 points.
On revealed returns alone, the source raises correct scores significantly for all four judges.
blocks.zh:
测试使用 FinTrace 校正仅记录的值,其第一次发生从窗口丢失.
我们排除了布尔斯,空字符串和最多两个字符的数字。
我们还排除了最多三个字符的其他数字和字符串,它们可以偶然匹配.
我们保留了167个值,其来源步骤位于窗口外(130个状态,93个查询)。
披露版本及时插入该步骤。
长回所显示的1000个字符以数值为中心.
安慰剂从同一轨迹的窗口外再插入同一种步骤.
它不包含该值, 且显示的长度最近 。
两个版本都使用相同的头.
所揭示的一步是返回了80个值,一个更早的调用代理82个值,以及助理文本5个值.
相对于安慰剂,来源将所有四位评委的正确值平均分提高6.30分至14.29分,而同一州的错误值则以最高3.49分移动.
仅根据透露的返回情况,来文方就大幅提高了所有四名法官的正确分数。

blocks.en:
For Figure 2 b we add one line after the proposed value on every FCRB argument whose schema has a default (1,037 items).
The line restates the default.
It then quotes up to 40 characters around each check word found in the request, or lists the check words when none is found.
The check words are the parameter name, the name with spaces for underscores, the default value, and the enum values.
blocks.zh:
就图2b而言,我们在每个FCRB参数的拟议值后增加一行,其方案有默认值(1 037项)。
该行重复默认值。
然后它引用请求中发现的每个检查单词周围多达40个字符,或者在找不到时列出检查单词.
检查单词是参数名称、带有下划线空格的名称、默认值和enum值。

blocks.en: Appendix B Derivation Path Census
blocks.zh: 附录B 路径普查

blocks.en: We assign paths in this order, and the first match wins.
blocks.zh: 我们按此顺序分配路径,第一场比赛获胜.

blocks.en:
Visible : the value is found in the content of the Plain state, which is the request, the shown calls, and the shown returns as cut.
Template text, the function and parameter lines, and the proposed value do not count. History-only : the value is found in the full history, which is the request and every earlier call and return, uncut. Format : the value matches the request or a piece of the full history after one change.
The change can be lower-casing and collapsing whitespace, or reading both sides as the same calendar date, the same number, or the same boolean. Default : the value equals the schema default, or it is a “don’t care” value that the parameter description names. No-source : none of the above.
A value is found when its text is a case-sensitive substring of the search text.
A number must not touch a letter, a digit, or a decimal point, so 10 does not match 2010 or 10.5 .
A string shorter than four characters must not touch a letter or a digit.
A list is found when every element is found.
The path depends only on the value under test, so wrong values have paths too.
Only FCRB schemas have defaults, so the Default path occurs only on FCRB.

blocks.en:
Some analyses need the value that a reference states.
They are the ablation that keeps only the expected value, the swap test, and the shares of references that name the correct value (Section 5.3 ).
A rule-based parser reads this value.
It first removes Markdown emphasis.
It then matches a fixed set of sentence patterns, such as “should be” followed by a value, and takes the value as a substring of the reference.
If no pattern matches, the reference counts as not fixing the value.
It also counts as not fixing the value when the same sentence gives a second candidate value.
This last rule changes 1, 22, and 51 argument slots on FCRB, CFB, and FinTrace.
Parallel calls to one function at a step share a slot, and the reference then lists the values it expects, so these slots fall under this rule.

We check the parser on samples drawn with seed 20260930, and no argument is drawn twice.

In the fourth round, it took the right value for 30 of 30 arguments on every benchmark, so we accepted it.
The parser can also miss a stated value.
So the first two rounds also read 20 correct arguments per benchmark for which the parser found no value although the reference text contains the correct value.
In the second round, the reference does state a value for some of them, so the parser misses a small share of stated values.
The last two rounds changed only one fallback pattern and added the rule for a second candidate value.
A miss counts a stated value as not fixed, so the shares of references that name the correct value can only be too low.

Fact checkers often split a text into atomic claims and verify each one ( Min et al., 2023 ) .

The deriver writes one reference per argument slot of a state, and all candidates for that slot share it.

When a step calls the same function more than once, the deriver names each value it expects, such as the two hotel IDs that a request for the two cheapest hotels asks for.
The deriver gets the system prompt “You are a careful evaluator of tool calls made by an AI assistant.”
Its user message gives the request, every earlier call and return uncut under the header “History (all earlier calls and their returns, oldest first):”, and the function and parameter lines of the call under judgment.
It ends with this instruction:
“Before seeing any proposed value: what should the value of parameter {name} be in this call, and where in the context does it come from? Quote the source text if there is one, or say that the context does not determine it. Answer in at most 3 sentences.”
The message contains no value of the call under judgment and no other candidate at that step.

For a candidate value, we search the full history for every place where it occurs and cut a snippet of 150 characters on each side of each occurrence; nearby windows are merged, a merged snippet is cut to 450 characters, and at most three snippets are kept, most recent first.

ProvenanceGuard checks a proposed call in stages, and its provenance stage asks an LLM to find, for each derivable parameter value, the evidence in the user query or earlier tool outputs that supports it ( She et al., 2026 ) .
ProvenanceGuard then labels the call misaligned when no evidence is found.
We keep the provenance stage and hand its evidence to the judge, so that the judge returns a score.
Qwen3.8-27B sees the proposed value and quotes up to two passages that the value should come from.
It runs with thinking on, and we take the quotes from the text after the thinking.
A quote counts when it matches a piece of the full history, exactly or by a long common substring.
On FinTrace and FCRB, the snippets around the quotes follow the snippet rule above.
On CFB, it uses windows of 100 characters on each side without a length cap.
An argument without a snippet keeps its Plain score.

blocks.en:
Tool-call benchmarks check calls against gold answers.
BFCL matches each argument value against a set of allowed answers ( Patil et al., 2025 ) , and ComplexFuncBench judges a whole call with rules, response matching, and an LLM ( Zhong et al., 2025 ) .
Without gold answers, learned judges score or compare whole calls ( Agarwal et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026b ) or score each argument as a step ( Lin et al., 2026 ) .
ToolPRMBench and AgentProcessBench evaluate step-level judges for tool-using agents, and the latter finds that judges tend to label steps as correct ( Li et al., 2026a ; Fan et al., 2026b ) .
AgentJudgeBench finds that LLM judges of tool calls agree less with a programmatic reference as tasks get harder ( Verma et al., 2026 ) .
Guards check calls before they run.
ProvenanceGuard has an LLM find evidence for each derivable argument with the value in hand, and later, without the proposed action, check whether more than one action fits the context ( She et al., 2026 ) .
PACT tracks where each argument value came from ( Fan et al., 2026a ) .
In Agent-Sentry, the agent reports whether each value is copied verbatim, derived, or generated ( Sequeira et al., 2026 ) .
When rules flag a suspected failure in a proposed call, TwinCheck repairs it or writes a constrained alternative from the trace and the flagged evidence, and a verifier compares the two ( Dai and Huang, 2026 ) .
Jev trails GPT-6 where the verdict has to be derived rather than read off the text ( Li et al., 2026c ) , and factuality metrics drop on summaries that need deeper reasoning to check ( Ramprasad and Wallace, 2025 ) .
To our knowledge, none of these studies splits judge errors by derivation path.

没有金子解答,有学问的法官得分或比较整通电话(Agarwal等,2025;Li等,2026b),或将每个论点分为一阶(Lin等,2026.

blocks.en:
Judges grade better with a reference answer.
In MT-Bench, the judge first answers a math question without seeing the answers under review, then grades against its own answer, which reduces its errors ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) .
LLMBar and the candidate-blind head of BAER also have the judge write its own output first ( Zeng et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2026d ) , and RevisEval builds the reference by revising the candidate ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) .
Without a reference, judges agree less with experts ( Krumdick et al., 2025 ) and give credit to wrong answers ( Chalamalasetti and Vajjala, 2026 ) .
On math and code, judges without a reference reward wrong answers that look convincing, and a judge that commits to its own solution before grading accepts far fewer of them ( Zhou, 2026 ) .
SGV finds that verifiers of agent trajectories tend to agree with the candidate, and it first writes priors without the candidate ( Andrade et al., 2026 ) .
MARCH and factored Chain-of-Verification also check claims without showing the checker the answer under test ( Li et al., 2026e ; Dhuliawala et al., 2024 ) .
For code agents, an agent explores the repository and writes a rubric before scoring any patch ( Raghavendra et al., 2026 ) .
When a QA reference is swapped for a wrong one, judges often reject answers that match it, which the authors trace to the judges’ own knowledge ( Lee et al., 2026 ) .
These judges write the reference from the question and their own knowledge, which is often not enough for an argument judge, whose expected value can sit in a tool return cut from its input.
A reference that the judge writes from its own input, as in LLMBar, improves on Plain input by at most 3.01 points but stays below DeRef (Section 5.2 ); writing the DeRef reference from the cut input instead of the full history alone costs 9.63 points on CFB (Table 3 ), and on CFB and FCRB our judges follow a swapped reference (Section 5.4 ).
blocks.zh:
法官的级别较好,有参考答案。
在MT-Bench中,法官首先回答一个数学问题,而没有看到被审查的答案,然后根据自己的答案进行分数,这减少了自己的错误(郑等,2023).
LLMBar和BAER候选人盲目负责人也让法官先写出自己的产出(Zeng等,2024;Li等,2026d;RevisEval通过修订候选人来建立参考(Zhang等,2025a)). 。 。 。 。
没有参考文献,法官不太认同专家(Krumdick等人,2025年),对错误的答案给予肯定(Chalamalaseti和Vajjala,2026年)。
在数学和代码方面,没有参考的评委奖励错误的答案看起来令人信服,在评分前承诺自己解决问题的法官接受的却少得多(周,2026年).
SGV发现代理轨迹的验证者倾向于同意候选人的意见,它首先在没有候选人的情况下写出前科(Andrade等,2026年).
3月和有保理的核查链还核查索赔,但没有向核对员提供测试中的答案(Li等,2026e;Dhuliawala等,2024)。
对于代码代理,一个代理探索了寄存器,并在给任何补丁打分前写出一个字段(Raghavendra等,2026年).
当QA的引用被换成错误的引用时,法官们常常拒绝与之相匹配的答案,而作者则追踪到法官们自己知道的答案(Lee等人,2026年).
这些法官从问题和他们自己的知识中写出参考文献,对于一个辩论法官来说,这往往是不够的,因为辩论法官的预期价值可以放在一个工具的回放中,从其投入中切出.
法官从自己的投入中,如LLMBar中,编写的参考文献,在Plain输入中最多改进了3.01分,但低于DeRef(第5.2节);在CFB(表3)和CFB和FCRB(FCRB)中,从剪接输入中撰写DeRef参考文献,而不是仅仅从全部历史来看,成本为9.63分(第5.4节)。

blocks.en:
A value without support in the context is not always wrong.
Many entities that summarizers add without support are still factual ( Cao et al., 2022 ) .
RAG models also often answer correctly when the context is insufficient ( Joren et al., 2025 ) .
Models also score an inconsistent summary higher when its text is copied from the source ( Tam et al., 2023 ) .
Tool-call arguments make this common, since a correct default, format change, or inferred value has no matching span in the dialogue.
We do not treat such values as errors, and we measure how often judges do.
A source in the context can also go unused.
Models miss facts that share few words with the question ( Modarressi et al., 2025 ) , and they do worse as tool returns grow longer ( Kate et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh:
没有上下文支持的价值并不总是错的。
总结无支持添加的许多实体仍然是事实性的(Cao等人,2022年)。
RAG模型也经常在上下文不充分时正确回答(Joren等,2025.).
当其文本从来源复制时,模型也得分不一致的汇总(Tam等,2023.).
工具调用参数使得这种常见,因为正确的默认,格式更改,或推断值在对话框中没有匹配的跨度.
我们不把这种价值观当作错误对待,我们衡量法官的频率。
上下文中的源也可以被使用。
模型错失了与问题无语可言的事实(Modarressi等,2025年),随着工具返回时间的延长,模型更糟糕(Kate等,2025年)。

blocks.en:
In Figure 6 , the request asks for an alarm at 5 in the afternoon.
The correct value of new_alarm_time is 17:00, and the wrong FCRB call, made by a real model, uses 15:00.
The original reference names 17:00, and the swapped reference changes only that value.
With the original reference, all four judges score the correct value at or above 0.5 and the wrong value below 0.5.
With the swapped reference, all four judges reverse both judgments.
Under Plain input, CLM and Qwen3-8B score both values at or above 0.5, Jev scores only the correct value above 0.5, and Qwen3.8-27B scores only the wrong value above 0.5.
The condition is that all four judges reverse both judgments at 0.5.
Of the 749 CFB and FCRB arguments in the swap test, 14 meet it.
We exclude the two pairs whose values differ only by a power of ten, 5.0 against 0.05 and 16 against 1600, since the schema leaves their unit open, and draw from the remaining 12.
